description: Clark Kent arrives in Metropolis, joins the Daily Planet beside Lois Lane and creates Superman so he can use his powers without surrendering his private life. Lois becomes fascinated with Superman while overlooking Clark, and their investigations repeatedly cross Lex Luthor, whose public charm masks a criminal empire and increasingly personal interest in Lois. The season builds toward Luthor's proposal and planned wedding to Lois as Clark, Perry, Jimmy and Jack race to expose him and Superman is trapped by kryptonite.

s01e01-02.description: Clark's parents devise a superhero persona so he can investigate Luthor's connection to the sabotage of a space shuttle.

s01e03.description: A covert government unit led by Jason Trask raids the Daily Planet while hunting Superman as a dangerous alien. Lois investigates the bogus agents as Clark follows their files for clues about the spacecraft that brought him to Earth and his own origins.

s01e04.description: Lex Luthor stages a succession of escalating emergencies to measure Superman's strength, speed and weaknesses, even putting innocent lives at risk. Meanwhile Lois's obsession with getting the definitive Superman story leaves Clark competing with his own alter ego for her attention.

s01e05.description: An invisible man terrorizes Metropolis, staging violent robberies and helping vicious criminals escape.

s01e06.description: Lois and Clark investigate some strangely powerful boxers - and Lois is surprised to discover the man behind their secret is her estranged father.

s01e07.description: Lois' undercover persona, a nightclub singer, arouses unexpected interest. Plus, can Superman halt the activities of a group of arsonists?

s01e08.description: Juvenile delinquents playing high-tech pranks are hooked on a dangerous drug that boosts intelligence.

s01e09.description: A friend of Jonathan and Martha has found a strange meteorite, Jason Trask is back and now he is in Smallville, looking for this meteorite that can destroy Superman, and Lois and Clark go to Smallville to investigate the story and Clark introduces her to his parents.

s01e10.description: A freak winter heat wave is blamed on Superman, and public pressure leads authorities to jail him as an environmental threat. Lois and Clark investigate the real cause while Metropolis discovers what happens when its protector is forced to sit out.

s01e11.description: A powerful perfume leads Lois to unleash her hidden feelings for Clark, who isn't too pleased with the situation.

s01e12.description: Lois and Clark cannot ignore their growing attraction to each other while posing as newlyweds during a surveillance operation.

s01e13.description: Superman's encounter with an asteroid headed for Earth results in amnesia for Clark, who forgets how to use his powers.

s01e14.description: Lois' life is in danger when she witnesses the murder of a scientist who was claiming to know the secret to increased male potency. Now, Clark and Perry need to protect her from the murderer, Mr Make-up, and from the scientist's affair from the past.

s01e15.description: Lois and Clark work to uncover the truth behind some strange disappearances that lead to mystery, magic, and a possible murder.

s01e16.description: Clark is skeptical as a sympathetic Lois harbors a fugitive and they search for an antidote to a world-threatening computer virus.

s01e17.description: As Clark begins to discover more about his mysterious past, Lex Luthor also learns more about Superman's true identity.

s01e18.description: Lois is overcome by jealousy when her college rival publishes several top news stories and also expresses a romantic interest in Clark.

s01e19.description: Clark senses a kindred spirit when he is confronted by a new enemy: a Superman clone determined to destroy the man of steel.

s01e20.description: Clark's true identity is in jeopardy when he is forced to save friends who are taken hostage when terrorists invade the Daily Planet.

s01e21.description: Clark may lose his position and his partner when Lex Luthor takes over both the Daily Planet newspaper and Lois' affections.

s01e22.description: As Lois prepares to marry Lex Luthor, Clark and the Daily Planet team assemble proof of Luthor's criminal empire. Luthor traps Superman in a kryptonite cage, leaving Clark to escape, stop the wedding and expose the man Lois is about to marry.
